text:
emily: Starting thread to lock alpha scope for the observability console. Goal: single "Overview" screen (dash + traces) + per-route cost rollups + error-slice alerts for two pilots. Need owners and firm launch gates.
raj: Pilot orgs: Beacon (prod) + Carely (staging). Beacon needs per-route cost snapshots; Carely needs alerting on degraded model routes.
cory: Engineering approach: runtime emits minimal trace metadata (model,route,tenant,token_count,quant_mode). Default sampling 1% and force-capture on errors. Expose X-RW-SAMPLE for QA. Keep span metadata <256 bytes and batch to producer.
lina: UX will ship Overview with three compact tiles: latency p50/p95, sampled cost trend, and error-rate by route + quick traces. No full dashboard editor for alpha.
ben: Ops constraints: telemetry retention 7d default. Full traces only when error=true or sampled_override. We'll gate longer retention behind enterprise flag. Canary: 2% traffic, region=us-east-1. Rollback if median latency delta >1% or telemetry backlog >45s for 10m.
qa-bot: qa-bot: test-harness created: k6 scenario + synthetic traffic for cost and alert checks -> /ci/obs-alpha-tests
emily: Proposed alpha acceptance gates: 1) Overview rendered with pilot data, 2) trace metadata present in pipeline, 3) per-route 7d CSV export for admins, 4) error-slice alerts configurable and firing in tests, 5) canary + rollback doc in ops runbook, 6) perf: median overhead <1% for pilot workload.
raj: Owners: product=emily, eng=cory, ux=lina, ops=ben, qa=qa-bot. Timeline: alpha in 5 weeks.
cory: Implementation plan split: Phase 1 (2 weeks) runtime hooks + sampling config + small telemetry schema; Phase 2 (3 weeks) cost rollups and UI plumbing. I'll file PR checklist: size limit, batching, feature-flag gate.
lina: I'll include help copy explaining sampling and why some traces are missing. Also a small "estimate cost" tooltip using model.profile + token_count.
infra-bot: infra-bot: feature-flag "obs_overview_alpha" created. telemetry topic retention set to 7d for alpha topics.
ben: Finance note: CSV fields for alpha: route_id, requests, total_tokens, est_cost; admin-only export. Accuracy target: within 10% on pilot data.
emily: Decision: lock scope as above. Action items: owners file short RFCs with perf/runbook + PR checklist by EOD Wed. Sign-off review next Monday 9am. Any blockers?
raj: One ask: add audit log event for sampling override changes.
cory: Noted, will emit sampling_change to audit stream.
emily: Thanks everyone. Meeting to review mocks + canary doc next Monday 9am. :rocket:
